Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.orgchart.ui.agenda

Class AgendaGrid

org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.SceneGraphObject
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.Node

org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg.Component3D
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.orgchart.ui.agenda.AgendaGrid
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg.event.LgEventSource
public class AgendaGrid extends org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg.Component3D
A week-view agenda grid rendered entirely at runtime into a single texture: seven day columns (Mon..Sun) by 10 one-hour rows starting at START_HOUR. User-created Appointments are drawn as coloured blocks; each block shows its title plus one chip per attendee, resolved against the desktop-wide address book (green = a live contact, grey = an unknown uid). This is the visible half of the one-way Agenda3D → Contacts interaction.

The grid follows the live-texture recipe used by Histogram3D: one fixed-size ImageComponent2D with ALLOW_IMAGE_WRITE is attached to a Texture2D once, off-live, and every later change only repaints the BufferedImage and calls ImageComponent2D.set(java.awt.image.RenderedImage) in place — no texture is ever re-attached to the live scene graph.

A left click maps the pick's local intersection back to a (day, hour) cell: clicking an occupied cell selects that appointment, clicking an empty cell moves the creation cursor there. Selection changes are reported through AgendaGrid.GridListener so the host can refresh its control strip.
